{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Repwardroid1.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The [[sentinel droid]] was an android used by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]]]
{{Quote|Most people have forgotten that 'droid' is short for 'android,' meaning ''manlike.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], complaining how little [[Vuffi Raa]] resembled a human|<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}
'''Android''' was a term that meant [[Human/Legends|''manlike'']]. The word [[Droid/Legends|''droid'']] was short for android.<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" /> However, the term later became synonymous with [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]], an [[Species/Legends|organic]] being with body parts replaced by [[Cybernetics/Legends|artificial ones]], particularly those who were [[Alien/Legends|non-human]].<ref name="Spain's Droids and Ewoks Novelizations">{{SW|url=news/of-androids-sidereal-beings-and-gourd-heads-spains-droids-and-ewoks-novelizations-part-2|series=Spain's Droids and Ewoks Novelizations|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> Like droids, androids were considered property and could be bought and sold.<ref name="The Lost Prince">{{DroidsCite|The Lost Prince}}</ref>
